news.title: PGB wins RM45mil data centre project

recent_en: PGLOBE recently completed several data-centre-related land deals: the RM238.3 million disposal of Land A was completed, and the RM398.1 million disposal of two land parcels to DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I was approved by shareholders at an EGM. The company also proposed a RM127.3 million acquisition of land in Kulai and obtained a Bursa Securities extension to submit the circular by 10 March 2027.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of 47.86 acres of land in Plentong to Bridge Data Centres Malaysia IV for RM238,317,195.60.
Shareholders at the EGM approved the disposal of two land parcels in Tanjung Kupang to DayOne Data Centers Malaysia I for RM398,107,091.20.
Proposed acquisition of a 753/1,000 undivided share in a parcel of land in Kulai for RM127,276,012.91, with Bursa Securities extending the deadline to submit the circular to 10 March 2027.
